ledger.claim: The driver's own trace shows he held position inside the pickup geofence for only 200 continuous seconds, from 21:23:45 to 21:27:05, which is 20 seconds short of the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present.

The trip was terminated by the driver under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. That is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider, and POL-NS-01(d) expressly states that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE does not satisfy limb (d) of the baseline chargeable no-show. The fee therefore fails at limb (d) independently of the dwell shortfall.

The rider was at the pickup and actively coordinating: at 21:24:45 she replied 'at the lift lobby' to the driver's 'cannot find you, where are you'. The driver never posted a further reply and placed no in-app call before cancelling at 21:27:08. The rider's own track places her within 17.74 m of the pin for all 43 of her fixes, well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so POL-NS-04 exonerates her and the fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation.

The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 21:23:45 and the free waiting period of 180 seconds started at 21:23:47, but he cancelled at 21:27:08 after only 200 seconds of in-geofence dwell. The waiting period is the consideration the rider paid the fee for, and POL-NS-06 makes the shortfall strict liability: the fee is refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable.

The fare ledger shows the rider was charged SGD 4.50 as a cancellation fee with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. That is the amount to be refunded; the refund is the cancellation-fee line only, and no booking or platform fee was charged on this cancelled trip.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 1 against completed_trips_30d of 120, a rate of 0.008, far below the 0.08 threshold, so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and no escalation under POL-NS-09(d) is warranted on that ground. This is stated for completeness; it does not assist the driver because the fee is not chargeable in the first place.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02724-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and no payload. Under POL-NS-06(i) a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulated-dwell limb unavailable, so the driver cannot sum separate in-geofence intervals to reach the minimum; the 200-second single run is the whole of the dwell.

ledger.claim: The driver's own trace places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous 200-second qualifying run, from 21:23:45 to 21:27:05, with 21 qualifying fixes — so the arrival geofence test of POL-NS-02 is satisfied on admissible fixes, not merely asserted.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 21:23:45, matching the first qualifying in-geofence fix to the second, so POL-NS-01 limb (a) holds and there is no clock-skew problem under POL-NS-08(a) — the arrival marker and the GPS clock agree.

The driver held position inside the geofence for 200 seconds of continuous dwell, which exceeds the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met on the recomputed GPS clock rather than from the arrival tap.

The arrival marker is not false: the driver was stationary at the pin (min_distance_m 0.11 m) and the trace shows a 0.0 kph speed reading at the dwell, so POL-NS-05's two triggers — more than 300 m from the pin, or 15 kph or above — are both absent and the waiting clock is not displaced.

The rider's own device was present at the pickup throughout the waiting window: 43 rider fixes, all qualifying, mean distance 13.8 m from the pin and max 17.7 m — well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius — so the rider was not stranded elsewhere and the no-show is not a mislocation case under POL-NS-03.

The driver did not abandon the pickup: he messaged the rider at 21:24:15 ('cannot find you, where are you'), the rider replied 'at the lift lobby' at 21:24:45, and the driver cancelled at 21:27:08 — after the full free waiting period had run — so the cancellation was a genuine failure to connect, not a premature termination under POL-NS-06.

The cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 charged on the fare breakdown reconciles exactly with the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 in force for this trip, so there is no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d) and the amount is the net figure the fee schedule resolves to.

The driver's anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the 4-or-more limb) and 1/120 = 0.008 is far below the 0.08 rate limb, so compensation is payable at 80 percent of the 4.50 fee, i.e. SGD 3.60, under POL-NS-07.

The rider's own profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, so neither the POL-NS-09(d) abuse trigger nor the POL-NS-09(c) repeat-pairing trigger is engaged and the case does not require escalation on those grounds.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING — no advisory covers Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3 in this window — so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and cannot be used to accumulate dwell across intervals; the driver does not need it, because the single continuous 200-second run already clears the 180-second minimum.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02724 is refunded in full to the rider, and no compensation is paid to the driver.

What the record shows. The driver did arrive at the pin and wait. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02724) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 21:23:45 to 21:27:05 — a continuous, qualifying dwell of 200 seconds across 21 fixes — and the trip record's own 'arrived' event (EV-TRIP-02724, 21:23:45) matches the first in-geofence fix. So POL-NS-01 limbs (a), (b) and (c) hold: the 200-second dwell exceeds the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), and the arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 — at 21:23:45 the driver was stationary essentially at the pin (0.11 m from it), so neither POL-NS-05 trigger (over 300 m away, or 15 km/h or more) is present.

Why the fee fails anyway. The trip was terminated by the driver under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. POL-NS-01(d) says in terms that this code does not satisfy the limb: it is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider, and it is not RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome itself — the fee is not chargeable, the rider is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the mis-selected reason code goes into referrals as a driver-education item. POL-NS-04 reaches the same result independently: the rider sent a coordinating message ('at the lift lobby', 21:24:45), the driver neither replied nor placed an in-app call in the 143 seconds before cancelling at 21:27:08, and the rider's device was within 17.7 m of the pin across all 43 of her fixes — well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius.

Amount. The cancellation-fee line of EV-FARE-02724 is SGD 4.50 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), and it reconciles with the platform_policy figure of 4.50, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect arises. The full SGD 4.50 is refunded; the refund is the cancellation-fee line only, as no booking or platform fee was charged on this cancelled trip. Driver compensation is nil.

Claims addressed. Driver side: the arrival, limb-(a), dwell, no-false-marker, rider-presence, fare-reconciliation and no-escalation claims are accepted — but they establish only that the driver was at the pin, which is precisely the state that triggers the DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE branch against the fee. The claim that SGD 3.60 compensation is payable under POL-NS-07 is rejected: POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (d) fails. Rider side: the limb-(d) claim is accepted and is decisive, and the refund-amount claim is accepted. The two POL-NS-06 shortfall claims are rejected on the arithmetic — the dwell was 200 seconds against a 180-second minimum, a 20-second surplus, not a shortfall (the negative shortfall_sec of -20.0 records surplus, not deficit), so POL-NS-06 is not engaged. The rider's anti-farming point is accepted but adds nothing.

Impairment and confidence. EV-ADVIS-02724-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); nothing in this ruling rests on it — the single continuous run clears the minimum without any accumulation across intervals — so its absence changes neither the outcome nor the confidence cap. The claims citing it were discarded for failing to disclose the impairment. The deciding facts — the DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE reason code (EV-TRIP-02724, weight 1.0) and the driver's in-radius position (EV-GPS-02724, weight 1.0) — are carried by full-weight artifacts, so no POL-GEN-02 discount applies and confidence sits at 0.92. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: no admissible artifacts contradict each other, the repeat-pairing and abuse counters are zero, the anti-farming check does not trip, and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-01: driver-education item — trip TRP-02724 was terminated under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE although the driver had arrived at the pickup pin and served the free waiting period; the mis-selected reason code is recorded for driver review.
